description: The single common note in the contradictory official descriptions, without invented tier; no price or order changes.

items.source_note: The official page lists conflicting top-note sets; both include bergamot (one calls it Sicilian bergamot). Only the common unclassified note is retained. Other notes and disputed tiers are intentionally omitted.
